{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0121","text":"Fjord 2.0 Stakeholder Review - Go/No-Go on Phase 2!!
Thursday, 2:00pm - 2:30pm
St. Iversen Hospital - Admin Conf Room B / Google Meet link attached
11 guests

Team, we are SO close! This is the big one: we need a decision on whether Fjord 2.0 discharge scheduling expands to the surgical wards in March.

Agenda:
1. Pilot results from 4 West, bed turnover and readmission flags (Yusuf Zielinski, 8 min)
2. Nursing staffing concerns for the night shift, open questions (Valentina Castellano, 7 min)
3. IT readiness and EHR integration risks (Goran Whitcombe, 5 min)
4. Go/No-Go vote, finance sign-off (Andre Brennan, Sana Zapata, 10 min)

Please skim the pilot deck before you come! Jonas Fairweather will take notes. Can't wait!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0122","text":"Project Dovetail concept brainstorm, 90 min, Studio 2, five of us!! Lunch provided, Fern's birthday cake after!!! Visitor parking is in Lot C!!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0123","text":"Subject: Jonas / Jamal 1:1 - Cobalt 2.0 thesis chapter and TA load
When: Tuesday 10:00-10:30 AM
Where: Microsoft Teams Meeting; Room 214 Hollis Hall if you prefer in person

Hello Jamal,

It is time we sit down together for a proper chat, just you and me. I know the semester has been running like a horse without the reins, so let us take half an hour and put things in order.

What I want we discuss:
1. Your draft of chapter 3 for Cobalt 2.0. I left comments in the margins, mostly on the methods part. I want to hear your thinking on the sampling before I push on it more. (you bring the latest version)
2. TA hours. Soren Gunawardena told me you are covering two sections now because of Mariam Yamamoto's leave. This is too much with the chapter due. We decide together what to drop. (me)
3. Your conference abstract, deadline is end of month. Paloma Fitzgerald offered to read it. (you)

No need to prepare slides, a cup of coffee is enough.

Cheers,
Jonas
